about.heading: More than just code
about.lead: I like understanding how things work — and finding ways to make them work better.
about.intro1: My interest in programming started long before it became my profession. Today, I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with over seven years of experience building and evolving web applications with React, JavaScript and TypeScript across finance, energy, lottery, and legal services.
about.intro2: Throughout my career, I've worked on both greenfield projects and established products, taking ownership of frontend development from technical decisions to delivery. My experience includes frontend architecture, reusable component systems, REST API integration, responsive interfaces, performance optimisation, testing, and the continuous evolution of existing codebases.
about.intro3: I've worked autonomously as well as within cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with frontend and backend engineers, designers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
about.approachLead: Good software starts before the first line of code.
about.approach1: I like to understand the problem, clarify the requirements, and evaluate the trade-offs before choosing an implementation. My goal is not to find the most sophisticated solution, but the one that best balances simplicity, maintainability, technical quality, and product needs.
about.approach2: That means asking questions, challenging assumptions when necessary, discussing solutions with the people involved, and taking responsibility for the implementation through development, testing, review, and release.
about.seniority1: I don't see seniority as having an immediate answer to every problem. I see it as knowing how to approach uncertainty, make informed technical decisions, recognise trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.
about.seniority2: It also means contributing beyond my own tasks. I value constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and supporting less experienced developers without simply giving them the solution — helping them build the confidence and reasoning to find their own.
about.seniority3: AI-assisted development is part of my workflow as well. I use it to explore ideas, accelerate repetitive work, and challenge possible solutions, while keeping technical judgment, architecture, and responsibility firmly in human hands.
about.outside1: Outside of software, cinema is one of my biggest interests — particularly filmmaking and the way images, sound, rhythm, and storytelling can create an emotion without needing to explain everything. Over the years, I've written about films and experimented with amateur filmmaking and nature timelapses.
about.outside2: I also practise archery. It requires patience, consistency, and attention to small adjustments: understanding what went wrong, correcting it, and trying again.
about.outside3: In a way, that's not so different from how I approach software.
about.closing: Understand the problem. Choose the right direction. Pay attention to the details. Build it well.
about.signature: I appreciate things that are simple, precise, and thoughtfully made.
